key_reasoning.reason: Retry/backoff logic (tenacity) wraps external Confluence calls in ConfluenceDatasourceLoader (_search_content_by_cql, is_public_page); transient-vs-permanent classification (SSLError explicitly not retried) and a new ConfluenceRetryExhaustedError need edge-case coverage. Reuses existing STORAGE_CONFIG retry settings, so only a modest divergence from precedent.

Single component (confluence_loader.py): retry decorator, transient-error predicate, exhausted-callback, and an is_public_page override; no layer boundary crossed beyond the loader-to-Confluence call.
